detailed_descriptions_html.en:
DJMAX RESPECT V - V LIBERTY V PACK!

Meet the 'DJMAX RESPECT V Original Song' package now!

This DLC includes a total of 20 original songs and videos, an original UI theme, an original gear skin, and more.

Now enjoy the songs of V Original Sounds in DJMAX RESPECT V.

※ V LINK 4 Special Bonus

If you own all of V LIBERY III PACK, V LIBERY IV PACK, and V LIBERY V PACK, a hidden V LINK reward song will appear upon achieving certain conditions.
